import re

def slugify_old(text):
    text = text.strip().lower()
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", text).strip("-")

def slugify_new(text):
    text = text.strip().lower()

    return re.sub(r"[^[:alnum:]]+", "-", text).strip("-")
